Strategy: Refine the distribution family with a tight-end peak: target a residual one item above the smallest residual, scoring bins by closeness to that target, with a bonus for an exact fit. The choice differs from Best Fit when the tightest bin sits below the target while a looser bin sits near it, so the second-tightest wins. This may fill bins, but the target can drift when the smallest is an outlier.

```python
def priority(item, bins):
    target = min(bins) + item
    return [(10000 if r == item else 0) - abs(r - target) for r in bins]
```
